name: Tracy Vilar
bio: Tracy Vilar was born on April 12, 1968 in New York City, New York, USA. She is an actress and casting director, known for Double Jeopardy (1999), K-PAX (2001) and Missing (2023). She has been married to Eric Daniel since September 2, 2000. They have two children.
place: New York City, New York, USA
